WI-FI TRANSFER

No cables needed.
Transfer music in your browser.

Transfer music from a computer through its web browser on the same local network—no additional transfer software required.

  1. 1
    Connect to the same Wi-Fi networkConnect your iPhone and the computer or other device to the same local network.
  2. 2
    Open File Browser in the appIn Music Player, open File Browser and tap “Start Server.”
  3. 3
    Open the address in a web browserOnce the server starts, enter the address displayed in the app into a web browser on the sending device.
  4. 4
    Upload your music filesSelect and upload your files in the browser, then check the imported music in the app.
This feature works on a local network. Check the app for the correct server address, and keep the app and server connection active while transferring files.
HELP CENTER

Frequently Asked Questions

Answers to common questions about using Music Player.

Can I listen to music without an internet connection?

Yes. You can play music stored on your device offline. Wi-Fi file transfers require both devices to be connected to the same local network during the transfer.

How do I transfer music from my computer?

Connect your iPhone and computer to the same Wi-Fi network. Open File Browser in the app and tap “Start Server,” then enter the displayed address in your computer’s browser to upload files.

I can’t connect using my web browser.

Make sure both devices are on the same network, the app’s server is running, and the address is entered correctly. Guest Wi-Fi client isolation or firewall settings may prevent the connection.

How can I adjust the equalizer, bass, or treble?

Use the Equalizer on the main screen to adjust 10 frequency bands, or open Audio Effects to customize bass and treble enhancement. Make sure the relevant effect is enabled.

My transferred songs are not showing up.

Refresh the Documents file list in File Browser and confirm the transfer completed. If a song was not automatically added to a playlist, add it from the playlist screen.

Need help with Music Player?

Find guidance on app features and file transfers here. For additional assistance, use the developer contact information shown on the app’s store listing.
